name: Cardio machine screen workout recap
summary: Point-down POV of a cardio machine touchscreen showing the workout recap UI; the user's torso is ghosted in the dark reflective glass, a water bottle and bunched clothing clutter the foreground, a row of cream ellipticals behind, glare and smudges over the glass.

colors.white_balance: warm indoor ambient mixed with a cooler cast on the bright screen UI
colors.contrast: high — dark reflective glass against a bright back room
colors.saturation: natural, warm neutrals with muted accents
notable_casts: warm brown cast inside the glass reflections
cool cast on the lit screen interface

sources: daylight through a glass wall behind
lighting.direction: overhead and from behind the camera position
lighting.hardness: mixed — soft ambient with hard speculars on the glass
artifacts: bright reflections of the room in the bezel

camera.angle: pointed down at the console screen from standing height
camera.depth_of_field: deep — screen UI and background machines both readable

composition.framing: screen fills the centre; console edge, bottle and clutter across the bottom
composition.subject_placement: the user appears only as a ghosted reflection, centre-right in the glass
composition.foreground: water bottle standing on the console, bunched-up sweatshirt across the bottom edge, second bottle cropped at the corner
composition.background: row of cream-and-grey ellipticals on a tan rubber floor, glass wall reflections above the screen
composition.negative_space: dark glass margins around the recap UI
composition.reflections: the defining element — the user's torso and raised phone ghosted inside the screen glass, ellipticals mirrored on the bezel

subject_treatment.pose_type: no posed subject — proof shot of the machine's recap UI (duration, calories, average power) with the user ghosted in the glass
subject_treatment.wardrobe_category: dark activewear visible only as a reflection

environment: cardio zone of a commercial gym: a console touchscreen in the near field, a row of elliptical trainers behind on tan flooring, glass wall catching room reflections
effects_imperfections: ghosted user reflection overlapping the UI
mild motion softness in the reflection
highlight clipping on cream machine shells

typography_overlay.position: centred near the top, ~25–28% down — just above the screen bezel

reusable_prompt_fragment: close POV shot of a cardio machine touchscreen showing a workout recap (duration, calories, average power) on dark reflective glass, user's torso ghosted in the reflection, water bottle on the console and bunched clothing in the foreground, row of cream ellipticals behind, overhead glare and fingerprint smudges on the glass, slight tilt, no face in frame
avoid: a pristine clean screen without glare or smudges
excerlock_fit: proof slide — third-act 'receipts' frame; the recap UI replaces the person as the subject
